sections.text:
هذا 
المستند يوضح خطوات الفحص كل 5 سنوات الخاص بنظام الاطفاء (بالمادة الرغوية) 
المستخدمة في سيارات الاطفاء.

أعد 
المسودة الأولية المهندس/ السيد احمد الدسوقى و اختبرها المهندس/ اسامة اسماعيل 
المشد و راجعها المهندس/ مصطفى النادى عبد الرحمن

و 
اعتمدها السيد المهندس/ فاروق عوض على رئيس قطاع محطة توليد كهرباء طلخا.

راجعها و وافق على المستند المهندس/ مدحت محمد خاطر مفتش السلامة و الصحة المهنية 
بقطاع التفتيش
و 
مراقبة الجودة- و وافق على المستند المهندس/ سمير عبد الجليل أحمد مدير عام 
التفتيش الفني بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء و منسق الشركة لنظام معلومات 
اجراءات الصيانة و وثق من السيد المهندس/ محمد نجيب عبد الحي رئيس قطاع 
التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء.

items:
اتباع اجراءات السلامة و الصحة المهنية للأفراد 
 و المعدات و ارتداء مهمات الوقاية الشخصية (خوذة آمان- حذاء آمان اوفرول- 
 جوانتي.......).
طلمبة صغيرة لإعاده ملىء المادة الرغوية
مادة رغوية حديثة الإنتاج مدة صلاحيتها 5 سنوات تكفى لملىء خزان الرغوى

rows: التأكد من تجربة تشغيل سيارة الاطفاء و صلاحيتها

التأكد من أن الفلاشر يعمل
ثانيا: نظام الاطفاء بالمياه
التأكد من سلامة خزان المادة الرغوية بدقة وعمل الصيانات اللازمة عند الحاجة

إستبدال المادة الرغوية المنتهية الصلاحية بآخرى صالحة لمدة خمس سنوات والتأكد 
 ان منسوب المادة الرغوية مثالى
احكام غلق الفتحة الخاصة بإعاده تعبئه المادة الرغوية

يتم 
 تسجيل تاريخ اعاده التعبئه ومدة الصلاحية على إستيكر ووضعه فى مكان ظاهر على 
 جسم خزان الرغوى

التأكد 
من صلاحية ملحقات نظام الرغوى
 البلوف
 الخراطيم 
 القواذف الخاصة بالمادة الرغوية 
 التأكد 
 من صلاحية وسيلة معرفة ( بيان) منسوب المادة الرغوية

ثالثا: 
 ملحقات سيارة الاطفاء
التأكد من وجود بدل مقاومة للحريق بمشتملاتها
التاكد من وجود جهاز تنفس صناعي و صلاحيته.
التأكد من وجود معدات الانقاذ (أحبال- مقص- عتلة- بلطة......)
التأكد من صلاحية السلم الخاص بسيارة الاطفاء.

sections_en.text: This document outlines the steps of the 5-yearly inspection of the foam fire-fighting system used in fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. El-Sayed Ahmed El-Desouky, tested by Eng. Osama Ismail El-Mashad, and reviewed by Eng. Mostafa El-Nady Abdel Rahman.
And approved by Eng. Farouk Awad Ali, Head of Talkha Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

items: Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).
Small pump for refilling the foam agent
Freshly produced foam agent with a 5-year shelf life, sufficient to fill the foam tank

sections_en.text:
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures

rows: Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
Make sure the siren works.
Make sure the flasher works.
Second: Water fire-fighting system
Make sure the foam agent tank is carefully inspected and carry out the necessary maintenance when needed.
Replace the expired foam agent with a valid one for five years, and make sure the foam agent level is ideal.
Tightly close the opening for refilling the foam agent.
Record the refill date and shelf life on a sticker and place it in a visible place on the foam tank body.

Make sure the foam system accessories are in working order:
 valves
 hoses
 foam nozzles
 Make sure the foam agent level indicator is in working order.

Third: 
 Fire truck accessories
Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present.
Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the 5-yearly inspection of the foam fire-fighting system used in fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. El-Sayed Ahmed El-Desouky, tested by Eng. Osama Ismail El-Mashad, and reviewed by Eng. Mostafa El-Nady Abdel Rahman.
And approved by Eng. Farouk Awad Ali, Head of Talkha Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Vehicle tool bag
Cleaning tools
Small pump for refilling the foam agent
Freshly produced foam agent with a 5-year shelf life, sufficient to fill the foam tank
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures
1. | Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
2. | Make sure the siren works.
3. | Make sure the flasher works.
Second: Water fire-fighting system
1. | Make sure the foam agent tank is carefully inspected and carry out the necessary maintenance when needed.
2. | Replace the expired foam agent with a valid one for five years, and make sure the foam agent level is ideal.
3. | Tightly close the opening for refilling the foam agent.
4. | Record the refill date and shelf life on a sticker and place it in a visible place on the foam tank body.
5. | Make sure the foam system accessories are in working order:
 valves
 hoses
 foam nozzles
 Make sure the foam agent level indicator is in working order.
Third: 
 Fire truck accessories
1. | Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present.
2. | Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
3. | Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
4. | Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.
